title: POST /api/v1/owner/2fa/enrol: request body (empty object)
description: W-42 5A rev 3 (contract 3.7.4). Owner UI via the proxy login only. The first enrolment needs the enrol window (BOARD_OWNER_2FA_ENROL_UNTIL); a re-enrolment needs an owner device. The response carries the seed and the backup codes once.
